cfp.rule: Five highest-ranked conference champions plus the seven highest-ranked other teams, seeded 1-12 straight by ranking; byes for seeds 1-4; first round on campus (5v12, 6v11, 7v10, 8v9)
cfp.note: 2025 rules assumed (straight seeding, five conference champions); not verified for this season

notes: Remaining regular-season games simulated from the blend ratings with correlated team strength draws.
Conference tiebreakers: win percentage, head-to-head among tied teams, then rating (proxy).
Committee ranking: resume proxy fitted on 2014-2025 CFP rankings, with noise.

CFP format: Five highest-ranked conference champions plus the seven highest-ranked other teams, seeded 1-12 straight by ranking; byes for seeds 1-4; first round on campus (5v12, 6v11, 7v10, 8v9) (2025 rules assumed (straight seeding, five conference champions); not verified for this season)
Bowl eligibility = 6+ wins including a conference title game; bowl games are not simulated.
